terra.problem: The passage does not say there was no negotiating or conversation.
The text does not say the men failed to ask nicely. It reports their words, not their manner.
The comparison about what the man could take off makes his physical difference the joke.
The passage does not say who remembered the man or why.
The passage does not say Jonathan was standing nearby when the man taunted Israel.
The passage does not name Absalom in this battle, but that does not establish that he had no part in it.
The passage identifies four descendants, but it does not give four names. Goliath’s brother and the man at Gath are not named.
